description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of three different models evaluated on two distinct benchmarks. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing the models evaluated, ordered from left to right as Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis is the value axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", featuring a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 70 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. The chart uses grouped bars, where each model category on the horizontal axis contains a pair of adjacent vertical bars. According to the legend in the top left corner, the left bar in each group, colored dark blue, represents the "MMAU" benchmark, while the right bar, colored dark purple, represents the "MMAR" benchmark. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 49%, and the MMAR bar is the shortest in the chart at roughly 30%. For Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU bar is about 61%, and the MMAR bar is approximately 37%. For Qwen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU bar is the tallest in the chart at approximately 65%, and the MMAR bar is about 57%. The categories do not appear to be sorted alphabetically or by a strict descending or ascending overall value, and there are no visually emphasized bars through shading, bolding, or outlining.
